That's unbelievable!"

62b7de8d-15eb-40b7-8e36-dfbe2dc5212d/Opt.en: (Sounds like they're talking about Shi Houjiu. I should wait and listen...)
62b7de8d-15eb-40b7-8e36-dfbe2dc5212d/Opt.ru: (Звучит так, будто они говорят о Ши Хоуджу. Я должен подождать и послушать...)

f72c7d04-0a19-48e8-9012-931d5e36c38d/Eve.en: "He says we're holding a Grand Tournament, but we're not even allowed to participate!<NL>Just because our styles don't match his so-called 'mainstream,' he calls us fringe or heretics. That's just bullying!"<NL>"The 'Emei legacy'—hah! That's just a cover. He's using it to crush anyone who doesn't bow to him!"<NL>"Why else would he allow his disciples to fight and kill each other before the Grand Tournament's even started?"

f72c7d04-0a19-48e8-9012-931d5e36c38d/Opt.en: (Seems they've suffered under him and now harbor deep resentment...)
f72c7d04-0a19-48e8-9012-931d5e36c38d/Opt.ru: (Кажется, они страдали при нем и теперь питают глубокую обиду...)

b25b3b1f-b89d-44c7-ba3d-94ffb90b6eb0/Eve.en: "Everyone, listen to me!"<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> steps forward, raising <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> voice,<NL>but before the words even finish, a powerful laugh echoes through the air.<NL>
b25b3b1f-b89d-44c7-ba3d-94ffb90b6eb0/Eve.ru: "Все, послушайте меня!"<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> делает шаг вперед, поднимая <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> голос,<NL>но еще до того, как слова заканчиваются, в воздухе разносится мощный смех.<NL>

f8617b97-7dd4-42f3-8b74-c7e1361d8c31/Eve.en: At first, it sounds no louder than regular speech.<NL>But in the wide open plaza, it smothers all other noise—<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s shout, the mutterings, even the cries of pain...<NL>All eyes turn toward the source: cold eyes, sharp gaze—it's none other than Shi Houjiu.
f8617b97-7dd4-42f3-8b74-c7e1361d8c31/Eve.ru: Поначалу это звучит не громче обычной речи.<NL>Но на широкой открытой площади он заглушает весь остальной шум—<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>чей-то крик, бормотание, даже крики боли...<NL>Все взгляды обращены к источнику: холодные глаза, острый взгляд — это не кто иной, как Ши Хоуджу.

fc088012-404a-4021-b9e8-0b6e66038913/Eve.en: "Seems you're all shaken by the bloodshed here and can't understand my intentions.<NL>And now that some of your kin, friends, or mentors lie wounded, resentment builds, rumors fly...<NL>You twist everything I've done out of context..."<NL><NL>Shi Houjiu walks out slowly from the Grand Hall,<NL>ten disciples behind him, faces cold and stern. Two of them carry a large sack.<NL>Silence falls over the plaza. Only the moans from the steps and distant clashes from the lower mountain can still be heard.

fc088012-404a-4021-b9e8-0b6e66038913/Opt.en: (Still no word on White Ape's condition. I can't act rashly...)
fc088012-404a-4021-b9e8-0b6e66038913/Opt.ru: (По-прежнему ни слова о состоянии Белой обезьяны. Я не могу действовать опрометчиво...)

ce22a8bf-4017-43c6-a6aa-56fe1561f135/Eve.en: "I could've stayed hidden, let you juniors fend for yourselves, and lived in peace.<NL>But the founder left me a final wish. I, as a disciple, can't ignore it.<NL>I've worked hard to uncover the truth behind all the recent murders, and just as I'm ready to share it, some of you dare stir up trouble?"

c3ff77b2-cfbb-4997-8cc4-d9453a546555/Eve.en: With a wave of his hand, one disciple hauls something from the sack and tosses it onto the ground.<NL>At first glance, it looks like a hunched old man.<NL>But on closer look, it's a tall white ape,<NL><NL>unconscious, bloodstained, and limp. Around his neck hangs a grotesque ornament,<NL>and they're made from dozens of human arm bones and tendons. Some still bloody. Others dry and crumbling...

4ffa0335-9732-451a-a4b1-21c2764e6d66/Eve.en: "This beast is vicious and cunning by nature, and has a taste for human hands.<NL>I went through great hardship to capture it in the mountains.<NL>Today, I will execute it before you all, to bring peace to the souls of our fallen disciples!"<NL><NL>The so-called "fringe disciples" who were just moments ago filled with anger now freeze in shock,<NL>jaws slack, stunned into silence.<NL>The rest, who already respected the reclusive elder, look even more convinced, and their faces are full of admiration...

4325421e-790e-479a-84f5-cedb41c67f27/Eve.en: "So it was you... I thought it was some ignorant fool misled by the beast, spouting nonsense.<NL>And here you are, showing up all on your own."<NL>Shi Houjiu narrows his eyes at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, then suddenly bursts into laughter.<NL>"Everyone, this person is the white ape's accomplice! A conspirator behind the slaughter of our disciples!"

fee9dc7a-1d91-4846-828c-00b1c6a962eb/Eve.en: "What a joke. I was chosen by the immortals,<NL>the founder's only surviving disciple. Everyone here has seen the proof with their own eyes..."<NL>Shi Houjiu raises his brows, then suddenly points straight at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> with fury.<NL>"You and the white ape have been in cahoots for days! You even killed sectmates at the cliffside. Did you really think I didn't know?"

fee9dc7a-1d91-4846-828c-00b1c6a962eb/Opt.en: Shi Houjiu! You lying snake! You've gone too far!
fee9dc7a-1d91-4846-828c-00b1c6a962eb/Opt.ru: Ши Хоуджу! Ты лживая змея! Ты зашел слишком далеко!

6151da16-fab6-4d12-b676-14fff00f1e74/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> burns with rage and steps forward, ready to argue.<NL>But before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> can take another step, a sharp zing cuts through the air—then another, and another. Blood bursts from the white ape's chest, arms, and legs.<NL><NL>Shi Houjiu moves like lightning, his two Emei piercers slithering like venomous snakes across White Ape's body.<NL>Though White Ape is still unconscious, his face twitches, and a low groan escapes his throat.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> freezes, terrified.

6151da16-fab6-4d12-b676-14fff00f1e74/Opt.en: (If I move any closer, White Ape will die...)
6151da16-fab6-4d12-b676-14fff00f1e74/Opt.ru: (Если я подойду еще ближе, Белая обезьяна умрет...)

be7c9ba7-e387-4a10-8f23-79aa57e76048/Eve.en: White Ape is covered in blood. Many watching can't bear the sight and shut their eyes.<NL>But Shi Houjiu shows no sign of emotion. His eyes, sharp as blades, lock onto <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>Then he shouts, "What are you waiting for? Seize this murderer now!"<NL>
be7c9ba7-e387-4a10-8f23-79aa57e76048/Eve.ru: Белая обезьяна вся в крови. Многие наблюдающие не могут вынести этого зрелища и закрывают глаза.<NL>Но Ши Хоуджу не проявляет никаких признаков эмоций. Его глаза, острые, как лезвия, устремлены на <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>Затем он кричит: "Чего ты ждешь? Немедленно схватите этого убийцу!"<NL>

431dc8ef-70ee-42fd-98a1-eb3c7801bd1b/Eve.en: The moment the words leave his mouth, four disciples leap from the crowd. In a blink, they surround <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and seal off every escape.<NL>They strike fast—fingers like knives—hitting <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s seventeen or eighteen acupoints in quick succession.<NL>One sweeps behind <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s knees. With a thud, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> drops to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> knees.<NL>Burning with fury, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> tries to speak, but only a dry rasp escapes. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mute point has been sealed too. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> can't even shout...

431dc8ef-70ee-42fd-98a1-eb3c7801bd1b/Opt.en: Despicable coward! You intend to wipe us all out?
431dc8ef-70ee-42fd-98a1-eb3c7801bd1b/Opt.ru: Презренный трус! Вы намерены стереть нас всех с лица земли?

65fad135-f230-44e1-bbad-f01aed3db6a6/Eve.en: Shi Houjiu stands above the crowd,<NL>looking down on everyone with smug authority. He raises his voice:<NL>"This sect fell prey to that white ape only because our legacy has gone astray!<NL>Too many have studied shallow arts and can no longer tell right from wrong.<NL><NL>Now, by the founder's last will, I take up the mantle once more,<NL>to cleanse our ranks, purge the heretics, and restore order through the tournament!<NL>We'll separate truth from falsehood, justice from evil, and return Emei to glory!"

65fad135-f230-44e1-bbad-f01aed3db6a6/Opt.en: (Vision spins... Grit the teeth, trying to stay conscious...)
65fad135-f230-44e1-bbad-f01aed3db6a6/Opt.ru: (Видение кружится... Стискиваю зубы, пытаясь оставаться в сознании...)

f324ab7a-2607-4271-9d6d-45ed4efe29c4/Eve.en: Shi Houjiu's eyes glint with pride.<NL>He glances at four elders now gathered at his side.<NL>"I've long grown weary of worldly affairs and have lived in seclusion.<NL>But because of the founder's last wish, I couldn't turn away.<NL>I couldn't bear to watch our disciples fall prey to monsters. So I returned, though I never wished to.<NL>From now on, I'll need all of your help to guide Emei back onto the righteous path!"

f324ab7a-2607-4271-9d6d-45ed4efe29c4/Opt.en: (Vision spins... Grit the teeth, trying to stay conscious...)
f324ab7a-2607-4271-9d6d-45ed4efe29c4/Opt.ru: (Видение кружится... Стискиваю зубы, пытаясь оставаться в сознании...)

64eabf7e-9b0b-4504-b01b-1c09683eb8e5/Eve.en: The four elders exchange looks. One steps forward, bows slightly, and says,<NL>"Elder Shi, allow me to speak. We've been working tirelessly to set things right. Disciples argue day and night over what is and isn't true legacy.<NL>Everyone is worn thin. If we carry out more bloodshed today, morale may collapse.<NL>And if word spreads, it could tarnish our name. The Martial World might think we've turned to infighting and fallen into a corrupted sect..."

64eabf7e-9b0b-4504-b01b-1c09683eb8e5/Opt.en: (Vision spins... Grit the teeth, trying to stay conscious...)
64eabf7e-9b0b-4504-b01b-1c09683eb8e5/Opt.ru: (Видение кружится... Стискиваю зубы, пытаясь оставаться в сознании...)

3c39fe78-42d9-4c33-8633-0e9fd52e02ba/Eve.en: Another elder respectfully adds,<NL>"I believe... perhaps it's better to delay the execution until tomorrow's Grand Tournament.<NL>That way, more can witness the punishment and understand the justice behind it. It would serve as a clear warning..."<NL>
3c39fe78-42d9-4c33-8633-0e9fd52e02ba/Eve.ru: Другой старейшина почтительно добавляет,<NL>"Я полагаю... возможно, лучше отложить казнь до завтрашнего Большого турнира.<NL>Таким образом, больше людей смогут стать свидетелями наказания и понять справедливость, стоящую за ним. Это послужило бы четким предупреждением..."<NL>

3c39fe78-42d9-4c33-8633-0e9fd52e02ba/Opt.en: (Vision spins... Grit the teeth, trying to stay conscious...)
3c39fe78-42d9-4c33-8633-0e9fd52e02ba/Opt.ru: (Видение кружится... Стискиваю зубы, пытаясь оставаться в сознании...)

aa3d83d6-e9e6-4e39-9cd4-7d5d948b888c/Eve.en: A flicker of cold light flashes in Shi Houjiu's eyes. But he quickly breaks into a smile.<NL>"You're right. I've been too focused on slaying demons and defending our legacy.<NL>I forgot... not everyone here has reached the level of immortals. Mortal hearts are fragile. They need time to adjust...<NL>Very well. I will return to the mountains soon enough. Emei is yours to lead, and small matters like this... are yours to decide."

aa3d83d6-e9e6-4e39-9cd4-7d5d948b888c/Opt.en: (Vision spins... Grit the teeth, trying to stay conscious...)
aa3d83d6-e9e6-4e39-9cd4-7d5d948b888c/Opt.ru: (Видение кружится... Стискиваю зубы, пытаясь оставаться в сознании...)

84b7c1ae-b60e-41b2-af9b-e51db92bdd6a/Eve.en: The lead elder replies, "I'll send someone to lock up the beast and his accomplice right away.<NL>At tomorrow's Grand Tournament, with your command,<NL>we'll bring them out and execute them before all...<NL>We'll handle the preparations. Elder Shi, please rest assured."
84b7c1ae-b60e-41b2-af9b-e51db92bdd6a/Eve.ru: Главный старейшина отвечает: "Я немедленно пошлю кого-нибудь запереть зверя и его сообщника.<NL>На завтрашнем грандиозном турнире вместе с вашей командой,<NL>мы выведем их и казним на глазах у всех...<NL>Мы займемся приготовлениями. Старейшина Ши, пожалуйста, будьте уверены."

84b7c1ae-b60e-41b2-af9b-e51db92bdd6a/Opt.en: (Can't hold on any longer. Darkness closes in...)

c0115988-e205-45a1-9253-d65baa8679e6/Eve.en: That night, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> slowly comes to. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> whole body aches like it's been crushed.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> tries to move and quickly realizes that <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> hands and feet are tightly bound with thick ox-hide rope.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/>'s tied up like a dumpling and thrown into a dark, cramped room. This must be one of Emei's prison cells...

eb591b7f-c40a-46bf-b1cf-2053d76c573e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> tried to circulate Qi, forcing it through meridians, but dantian was hollow, and meridians completely sealed off.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> barely managed to raise a thread of Qi, but it vanished instantly, like a stone sinking into the sea.<NL>It was unclear whether the Emei pressure-point technique was just too precise, or if someone had fed <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> the concoction to dissolve <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> True Qi entirely...<NL>

eb591b7f-c40a-46bf-b1cf-2053d76c573e/Opt.en: (White Ape... I hope he's still okay...)
eb591b7f-c40a-46bf-b1cf-2053d76c573e/Opt.ru: (Белая обезьяна... Я надеюсь, с ним все еще все в порядке...)

a4809fba-6bd3-4d0d-b721-6daceb2a87c9/Eve.en: The cell isn't big. High up, there's a small window.<NL>Through the faint moonlight, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> suddenly spots White Ape curled up in a corner.<NL>He's covered in blood, still wearing that grotesque necklace of severed hands. His eyes are shut...<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> doesn't know if he's dead or alive. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> grits <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> teeth and slowly cuns closer.<NL>When <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> finally gets close enough, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> breathes a small sigh of relief. White Ape's chest is still rising and falling, however faintly, and he's breathing through his nose.<NL>

f8a7cbf7-4ddd-4cfa-878c-b41ae6ed4eae/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> tries to call out, but <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> throat only produces a raspy wheeze. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/>'s still gagged. And <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> limbs are still bound.<NL>If <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> crawls closer and accidentally bumps into White Ape, it might make his injuries worse.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> decides instead to bump <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> body lightly against the wall, hoping to make a sound and alert White Ape...<NL>

f8a7cbf7-4ddd-4cfa-878c-b41ae6ed4eae/Opt.en: (Maybe they sealed his sleep point... That's why he won't wake up...)
f8a7cbf7-4ddd-4cfa-878c-b41ae6ed4eae/Opt.ru: (Может быть, они запечатали его точку сна... Вот почему он не просыпается...)

8ece14f2-fd47-4163-ae75-faaca04871f3/Eve.en: Just then, there's a sudden stir in the dark.<NL>Torches flare to life near the corner of the corridor. Someone yells, "Who goes the—"<NL>Before the sentence finishes, it's cut off by a few dull thuds. Then silence again...<NL>
8ece14f2-fd47-4163-ae75-faaca04871f3/Eve.ru: Как раз в этот момент в темноте происходит внезапное шевеление.<NL>В углу коридора вспыхивают факелы. Кто—то кричит: "Кто идет на..."<NL>Прежде чем предложение заканчивается, его прерывают несколько глухих ударов. Затем снова наступила тишина...<NL>

8ece14f2-fd47-4163-ae75-faaca04871f3/Opt.en: (Did someone just knock out the guards? But why...?)
8ece14f2-fd47-4163-ae75-faaca04871f3/Opt.ru: (Неужели кто-то только что вырубил охранников? Но почему...?)

a8a8a09a-b322-44fe-aa0f-fd4578d56161/Eve.en: Four masked figures in black burst into the cell.<NL>The one in the lead rushes over to untie <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, whispering,<NL>"We've all got a bone to pick with Emei. Heard they locked you up too—so that makes you one of us.<NL>We're busting you out. Then tomorrow, during the Grand Tournament, we sneak into the rear temple of the Jingding Hall,<NL>find the wounded disciples, and paint the floor red. After that, we vanish. Won't that be a thrill?"

be24ebce-453a-4a7a-9fdb-34500c44f874/Eve.en: The black-robed one finishes untying <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, but <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> still isn't moving.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes are wide with fury, and though <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> tries to speak, no sound comes out.<NL>The black-robed one realizes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is still paralyzed. He immediately starts pressing pressure points to restore circulation.<NL>Clearly, he knows Emei techniques well. After a moment, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can move a little and finally speak...

be24ebce-453a-4a7a-9fdb-34500c44f874/Opt.en: You rats, kicking people when they're down. I don't need your rescue!
be24ebce-453a-4a7a-9fdb-34500c44f874/Opt.ru: Вы, крысы, пинаете людей, когда они падают. Я не нуждаюсь в твоем спасении!

be24ebce-453a-4a7a-9fdb-34500c44f874/Opt.en: Thanks for saving me, but if you're planning something shady, I'm stopping you...
be24ebce-453a-4a7a-9fdb-34500c44f874/Opt.ru: Спасибо, что спас меня, но если ты планируешь что-то сомнительное, я тебя останавливаю...

be24ebce-453a-4a7a-9fdb-34500c44f874/Opt.en: Emei may have locked me up, but that doesn't make me your ally. I'm not going with you...
be24ebce-453a-4a7a-9fdb-34500c44f874/Opt.ru: Может, Эмэй и запер меня, но это не делает меня твоим союзником. Я не пойду с тобой...

be24ebce-453a-4a7a-9fdb-34500c44f874/Opt.en: I've been wronged by Emei, but I want them to admit their mistake and let me go with honor, not sneak out on my own.
be24ebce-453a-4a7a-9fdb-34500c44f874/Opt.ru: Эмэй поступил со мной несправедливо, но я хочу, чтобы они признали свою ошибку и отпустили меня с честью, а не улизнули в одиночку.

be24ebce-453a-4a7a-9fdb-34500c44f874/Opt.en: If I don't clear my name and just follow you around killing people, it'll ruin everything I stand for!
be24ebce-453a-4a7a-9fdb-34500c44f874/Opt.ru: Если я не очищу свое имя и просто последую за тобой, убивая людей, это разрушит все, за что я выступаю!

e5500f53-5d43-45ed-bf08-c44b673d312a/Eve.en: "What are you saying?<NL>Without us, you'd still be rotting in that corner. You wanna wait till tomorrow and let them slice off your head?<NL>Emei's already fallen into chaos. Just pretend the sect doesn't exist anymore!"
e5500f53-5d43-45ed-bf08-c44b673d312a/Eve.ru: - О чем ты говоришь?<NL>Без нас ты бы до сих пор гнил в этом углу. Ты хочешь подождать до завтра и позволить им отрезать тебе голову?<NL>Эмэй уже погрузился в хаос. Просто притворись, что Секты больше не существует!"

e5500f53-5d43-45ed-bf08-c44b673d312a/Opt.en: You don't need to try convincing me. I've got no grudge against Emei. I won't dirty my hands with you.
e5500f53-5d43-45ed-bf08-c44b673d312a/Opt.ru: Тебе не нужно пытаться убедить меня. Я не держу зла на Эмэй. Я не буду марать о тебя руки.

e5500f53-5d43-45ed-bf08-c44b673d312a/Opt.en: Their disciples might be misled, but right and wrong still matter. I can't just walk away from that...
e5500f53-5d43-45ed-bf08-c44b673d312a/Opt.ru: Их ученики могут быть введены в заблуждение, но правильное и неправильное по-прежнему имеют значение. Я не могу просто так уйти от этого...

e5500f53-5d43-45ed-bf08-c44b673d312a/Opt.en: I've made up my mind. I'm not going with you. Maybe there's still a chance tomorrow for the truth to come out...
e5500f53-5d43-45ed-bf08-c44b673d312a/Opt.ru: Я принял решение. Я не пойду с тобой. Может быть, завтра еще есть шанс, что правда всплывет наружу...

e5500f53-5d43-45ed-bf08-c44b673d312a/Opt.en: I said I'm not going. Even if I die here, I'll come back as a ghost just to make Emei pay me proper respect!
e5500f53-5d43-45ed-bf08-c44b673d312a/Opt.ru: Я сказал, что не пойду. Даже если я умру здесь, я вернусь призраком, просто чтобы заставить Эмэй проявить ко мне должное уважение!

e5500f53-5d43-45ed-bf08-c44b673d312a/Opt.en: No one knows how tomorrow will turn out. I'm not afraid to find out.
e5500f53-5d43-45ed-bf08-c44b673d312a/Opt.ru: Никто не знает, как сложится завтрашний день. Я не боюсь это выяснить.

ef58e5c4-19b6-4a5e-b8a7-e6e856d50a16/Eve.en: "So that's your choice? Fine..."<NL>The black-robed one says with a cold laugh. "In that case, once we've got the ape out of here,<NL>I'll just run you through right now. I can't risk you ratting us out to Shi Houjiu tomorrow."<NL>Shing! He draws his sword. The cold blade presses against <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s neck, sharp enough to bite...

ef58e5c4-19b6-4a5e-b8a7-e6e856d50a16/Opt.en: (Fuyu... Fuyu... Looks like the only hope left is you. Please find another successor. Help clear my name...)
ef58e5c4-19b6-4a5e-b8a7-e6e856d50a16/Opt.ru: (Фую... Фую... Похоже, единственная оставшаяся надежда - это ты. Пожалуйста, найдите другого Преемника. Помоги очистить мое имя...)

1cf25c51-4707-4b1d-ad7f-201fd6563b7a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> faces death head-on,<NL>lifts <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> chin, straightens <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> back, and braces for the killing blow.<NL>But after a long while, nothing happens.<NL>Instead, the four black robed men glance at each other, then silently nod and begin removing their face coverings one by one...<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s eyes go wide in shock.<NL>The faces underneath are the same four Emei elders who earlier tried to stop Shi Houjiu from executing anyone on the spot!

191f5110-e980-4623-9892-ddd0bb915571/Eve.en: "What you said before... it had no proof, and was hard to believe.<NL>But you were willing to die for Emei. That alone makes it hard to believe you're the one behind the murders...<NL>Besides, the world's already a mess. The disaster from Xiangshu still threatens us all.<NL>If we kill the Successor of Taiwu now, aren't we just making more enemies?<NL>Whatever the truth is, it wouldn't make sense to let you die over this. So everything that just happened... please treat it as a misunderstanding. Just leave quietly..."

12f109c5-6910-455d-a678-29b023688b3c/Eve.en: "We've arranged a banquet for Elder Shi.<NL>He'll be well entertained and won't trouble you tonight...<NL>If he asks where you went, we'll say some mysterious master broke into the prison and took you..."
12f109c5-6910-455d-a678-29b023688b3c/Eve.ru: - Мы устроили банкет в честь старейшины Ши.<NL>Его хорошо развлекут, и он не побеспокоит вас сегодня вечером...<NL>Если он спросит, куда ты делся, мы скажем, что какой-то таинственный хозяин вломился в тюрьму и забрал тебя..."

12f109c5-6910-455d-a678-29b023688b3c/Opt.en: If I leave alone... won't that put White Ape in danger tomorrow?
12f109c5-6910-455d-a678-29b023688b3c/Opt.ru: Если я уйду один... не подвергнет ли это Белую обезьяну опасности завтра?

e43df05e-a82f-4473-8076-74ce3742bffe/Eve.en: "Shi Houjiu already called White Ape the killer in front of everyone.<NL>He even showed the severed hands as evidence. We can't just override that and release someone labeled as the murderer.<NL>If the thousand-year legacy of Emei were to fall apart in one night, how would we explain that to the world?"<NL>The lead elder says, "Don't get us wrong. We're not trying to make things harder for you..."<NL><NL>At that moment, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> suddenly remembers something. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> reaches into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> clothes and it's still there!

e43df05e-a82f-4473-8076-74ce3742bffe/Opt.en: I have something I'd like you to see...
e43df05e-a82f-4473-8076-74ce3742bffe/Opt.ru: У меня есть кое-что, что я хотел бы вам показать...

5fae0b1e-4028-4553-bfca-9d5bd063cc98/Eve.en: "This was entrusted to me by White Ape,"<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> says, pulling out the Ancestor's Secret Order.<NL>"It was a personal gift from the founder of Emei himself." The elders all freeze. They quickly take the token and examine it closely. Their foreheads begin to sweat. Their hands tremble.<NL>One of them even drops to his knees, whispering, "Founder above!"<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> quickly urges him to rise and briefly explains the whole story...

5fae0b1e-4028-4553-bfca-9d5bd063cc98/Opt.en: White Ape has deep ties to Emei. He just doesn't like appearing in public. That's why no one knew...
5fae0b1e-4028-4553-bfca-9d5bd063cc98/Opt.ru: Белая обезьяна имеет глубокие связи с Эмэем. Он просто не любит появляться на публике. Вот почему никто не знал...

5feb22ff-6957-439e-b7f2-d5a9c65b4cd8/Eve.en: The token looks old, solid, and real—hard to fake.<NL>And <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s story is clear, without contradictions.<NL>If <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> were making it up, there's no way <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> could improvise something so detailed so fast...<NL>

7d2954aa-8298-4bcf-9984-056b68d462ec/Eve.en: The lead elder suddenly places three fingers on White Ape's wrist and checks his pulse.<NL>"His blood and Qi are dangerously weak,<NL>but waking him won't be too hard. The four of us can combine our True Qi to heal him..."<NL><NL>That kind of healing takes a serious toll on one's own True Qi. Most wouldn't do it unless the bond was deep.<NL>Clearly, the elder now fully trusts <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...

b9b1479e-aece-4c45-bdac-890b46cad6ae/Eve.en: More than half an hour passes. White Ape's body suddenly jolts, and he coughs up a mouthful of clotted blood.<NL>His eyes slowly open, with confusion and surprise...<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> quickly tells him everything that's happened.<NL>White Ape listens silently, then lets out a long sigh. Tears quietly stream down both cheeks...

b9b1479e-aece-4c45-bdac-890b46cad6ae/Opt.en: Sir, you're badly hurt. Please don't let sorrow stir your energy too much...
b9b1479e-aece-4c45-bdac-890b46cad6ae/Opt.ru: Сэр, вы серьезно ранены. Пожалуйста, не позволяй печали слишком сильно размешивать твою Энергию...

af784256-c55f-441a-9bf2-ddee5e1a536d/Eve.en: "So all this disaster was because I trusted the wrong person..."<NL>White Ape shakes his head, eyes dim. "Back then, Shi came to me claiming he had changed. Said he was done with evil.<NL>He swore and begged. I believed him. I let him become my disciple. I thought we'd rebuild Emei together...<NL>I didn't realize... the whole time, he was just biding his time to take revenge on me and destroy Emei..."

af784256-c55f-441a-9bf2-ddee5e1a536d/Opt.en: Please tell us the full story from the beginning...
af784256-c55f-441a-9bf2-ddee5e1a536d/Opt.ru: Пожалуйста, расскажите нам всю историю с самого начала...

e14544f9-7ac7-419b-90be-f18c6bc350c2/Eve.en: White Ape nods slowly.<NL>He lets out a deep breath and begins...
e14544f9-7ac7-419b-90be-f18c6bc350c2/Eve.ru: Белая обезьяна медленно кивает.<NL>Он делает глубокий вдох и начинает...

78cd88b4-b883-4b9c-9426-fdc2959ab134/Eve.en: A thousand years ago, before the Emei Sect even existed, there was a monster in these mountains.<NL>The locals called him the 'Winged King.'<NL>He led a horde of monsters and terrorized the whole region. The people suffered horribly...<NL>White Ape first heard of these events when he rescued the Emei founder, who had been wounded by the Winged King.

0c89bb92-9e9b-4944-bb78-efa6b3ec989c/Eve.en: At the time, the founder was just a young Taoist. He happened upon the area and heard the villagers' cries.<NL>Without hesitation, he charged into the mountain alone to slay the monster. He's brave enough, but reckless.<NL>Unsurprisingly, he was badly injured. He didn't manage to kill a single monster and barely escaped with his life.<NL>He collapsed deep in the forest...

d83e887e-bc45-4134-8cc5-fa2222a88c70/Eve.en: Funny how fate works.<NL>If he hadn't gone up the mountain, he wouldn't have been hurt.<NL>But if he hadn't been hurt, he wouldn't have met White Ape. And White Ape wouldn't have saved him, or taught him martial arts...
d83e887e-bc45-4134-8cc5-fa2222a88c70/Eve.ru: Забавно, как устроена судьба.<NL>Если бы он не поднялся на гору, с ним бы ничего не случилось.<NL>Но если бы он не был ранен, он бы не встретил Белую обезьяну. И Белая Обезьяна не спасла бы его и не научила бы Боевым искусствам...

3cbedaad-2e08-4609-a38f-071a624620db/Eve.en: Back then, Mt. Emei was remote and rugged, with barely a soul passing through.<NL>White Ape lived in seclusion and never mingled with other mountain spirits or beasts,<NL>so he had no idea the Winged King even existed, let alone that the mountain had long been overrun by monsters and no one dared set foot here.<NL>Now, meeting the young Taoist and seeing his fine Root Bone and good heart, White Ape suddenly has the idea to take him in as a disciple...

436d6941-0727-47fb-ba8f-96a8ce85cdd8/Eve.en: Years fly by like a blink.<NL>By the time White Ape finally lays eyes on the so-called "Winged King" the Taoist once spoke of,<NL>the monster has already taken on human form and seems like a completely different being.<NL>He calls White Ape "Master" with every breath, begs to become his disciple, swears he's turned over a new leaf, and confesses his past crimes one by one,<NL>promising never to repeat them.<NL>He even volunteers to patrol Emei, watch for troublemakers, and help train junior disciples...

344506da-068c-4ed5-81fe-0791daedd3eb/Eve.en: "That monster was Little Shi,"<NL>White Ape says with a long sigh.<NL>"The one you call... Shi Houjiu."<NL>His expression is beyond words. The four elders beside him are stunned speechless. Heads hung low, they're drowning in shame.
344506da-068c-4ed5-81fe-0791daedd3eb/Eve.ru: "Этим чудовищем был Малыш Ши",<NL>- говорит Белая обезьяна с долгим вздохом.<NL>- Тот, кому ты звонишь... Ши Хоуджу."<NL>Выражение его лица невозможно передать словами. Четверо старейшин рядом с ним ошеломлены и лишились дара речи. Низко опустив головы, они тонут в стыде.

609187b9-bfc7-4782-825d-d2c5fec2a484/Eve.en: By now it's deep into the night. The Grand Tournament begins in less than six hours.<NL>The four elders each react differently—some wear a grim look, some tremble in rage.<NL>"We were blind... We wronged the good..."<NL>"Thank heaven we managed to wake up White Ape in time..."<NL>"But the situation is a mess. It'll be hard to change everyone's view overnight..."<NL>"Just thinking about facing that traitor Shi Houjiu tomorrow makes me want to strike him down right now..."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> listens, deep in thought...

609187b9-bfc7-4782-825d-d2c5fec2a484/Opt.en: I have an idea. May I run it by you?
609187b9-bfc7-4782-825d-d2c5fec2a484/Opt.ru: У меня есть идея. Могу я обсудить это с вами?

8a20e3d8-965f-456f-9fad-d921ded1ddd0/Eve.en: Though <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> hasn't known Shi Houjiu for long, the few encounters they've had already reveal plenty about the man's personality.<NL>So <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> lays out the full plan clearly and logically.<NL>White Ape chimes in, backing up the story with small details from his time with Shi.<NL>The elders examine everything together, discussing his habits, pointing out flaws, and soon agree: to take him down, they need to target his pride. A direct fight won't work. They'll have to outsmart him...

779da11f-aa75-47ba-886b-1dacc584e7ea/Eve.en: After hearing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s plan,<NL>all four elders go from worried to hopeful. Even White Ape cracks a faint smile.<NL>Everyone gets to work. All is in place. Now they just have to wait for the Grand Tournament to begin and act according to plan, to expose Shi Houjiu's true color...

779da11f-aa75-47ba-886b-1dacc584e7ea/Opt.en: (I should rest up and save my strength for tomorrow...)
779da11f-aa75-47ba-886b-1dacc584e7ea/Opt.ru: (Мне следует отдохнуть и приберечь свои Силы для завтрашнего дня...)

97bf6d91-b4bf-4229-9fc4-c9028b82c4c4/Eve.en: When morning comes, the Emei Jingding Hall is freshly decorated.<NL>Shi Houjiu sits proudly at the head seat, calm and poised, looking more handsome and composed than ever.<NL>The younger generation present all feel dwarfed by his presence. Many of the female disciples sneak glances at him, cheeks flushed red.

28a3f9e0-5b25-469a-b90b-e6d6223ea1ac/Eve.en: "Bring in the criminal and his accomplice!"<NL>At the elder's command, White Ape and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> are carried in on a stretcher, four disciples lifting them together into the hall.<NL>
28a3f9e0-5b25-469a-b90b-e6d6223ea1ac/Eve.ru: "Приведите преступника и его сообщника!"<NL>По приказу старейшины Белая обезьяна и <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> их вносят на носилках, четверо учеников вместе поднимают их в зал.<NL>

d01227af-4033-49ef-993a-5e4de7612b5c/Eve.en: "Please stay calm, everyone. Today's Grand Tournament is held for two reasons.<NL>First, through martial duels and debate, we'll settle once and for all which styles are true legacy—cleansing Emei of its unworthy branches.<NL>In a moment, all disciples and elders may step forward and test their skills. If you lose, and cannot match your opponent...<NL>Then according to Elder Shi's decree, your entire faction will be wiped out!"

d01227af-4033-49ef-993a-5e4de7612b5c/Opt.en: (Just one defeat, and he's ready to kill a whole faction... How cruel can he be?)
d01227af-4033-49ef-993a-5e4de7612b5c/Opt.ru: (Всего одно поражение, и он готов уничтожить целую Фракцию... Насколько жестоким он может быть?)

28b13784-532b-4c22-ab3b-34a2698f40a7/Eve.en: The crowd erupts in shock.<NL>Faces pale. Some disciples start sweating and trembling.<NL>But Shi Houjiu just smiles and raises his wine cup. He looks very pleased with how the elder has delivered his message...
28b13784-532b-4c22-ab3b-34a2698f40a7/Eve.ru: Толпа взрывается от шока.<NL>Лица бледнеют. Некоторые ученики начинают потеть и дрожать.<NL>Но Ши Хоуджу только улыбается и поднимает свой кубок с вином. Он выглядит очень довольным тем, как старейшина передал свое послание...

28b13784-532b-4c22-ab3b-34a2698f40a7/Opt.en: (Hold steady and wait for him to approach...)
28b13784-532b-4c22-ab3b-34a2698f40a7/Opt.ru: (Стойте спокойно и ждите, пока он приблизится...)

a4c0c9b4-85a1-44da-b9d8-0761a580651d/Eve.en: "If we want to carry forward Emei's legacy,<NL>we must endure hardship. There's no reason to keep weak, useless martial arts around.<NL>Or do you want the Martial World to laugh at us? Should we allow our sectmates to be mocked and shamed?"
a4c0c9b4-85a1-44da-b9d8-0761a580651d/Eve.ru: "Если мы хотим продолжить наследие Эмэя,,<NL>мы должны переносить трудности. Нет никакой причины держать при себе слабых, бесполезных Боевых искусствах.<NL>Или ты хочешь, чтобы Мир боевых искусств смеялся над нами? Должны ли мы позволить, чтобы над нашими товарищами по секте насмехались и стыдили их?"

a4c0c9b4-85a1-44da-b9d8-0761a580651d/Opt.en: (He says it so convincingly, even I almost fell for it...)
a4c0c9b4-85a1-44da-b9d8-0761a580651d/Opt.ru: (Он говорит это так убедительно, что даже я чуть не купился на это...)

9f1cd974-2cc8-4462-bfd6-721cec5e7dd1/Eve.en: The elder cuts off the murmuring with a sharp gesture and a shout.<NL>The hall falls silent again.<NL>"The second matter," he continues, "will be the public execution of the murderers once the duels are complete, to show Emei's resolve and restore our prestige!"<NL>
9f1cd974-2cc8-4462-bfd6-721cec5e7dd1/Eve.ru: Старейшина обрывает ропот резким жестом и криком.<NL>В зале снова воцаряется тишина.<NL>"Вторым делом, - продолжает он, - будет публичная казнь убийц после завершения дуэлей, чтобы показать решимость Эмэй и восстановить наш Престиж!"<NL>

9f1cd974-2cc8-4462-bfd6-721cec5e7dd1/Opt.en: (If I don't react at all now, that bastard might get suspicious...)
9f1cd974-2cc8-4462-bfd6-721cec5e7dd1/Opt.ru: (Если я сейчас вообще не отреагирую, этот ублюдок может что-то заподозрить...)

02e25ed1-b5e7-4061-ad9c-87ab19e849d4/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> trembles with rage at those words, but no matter how hard <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> struggles,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/>'s still stuck flat on the stretcher, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> can't even lift a hand, let alone rise to fight.<NL>White Ape, meanwhile, keeps his eyes shut tight, brows faintly furrowed, as if still deep in unconsciousness...<NL>

02e25ed1-b5e7-4061-ad9c-87ab19e849d4/Opt.en: (Now I see... faking it is way harder than showing how you really feel...)
02e25ed1-b5e7-4061-ad9c-87ab19e849d4/Opt.ru: (Теперь я понимаю... притворяться намного сложнее, чем показывать, что ты чувствуешь на самом деле...)

210dcdd1-f5d5-4156-abf6-9bc7a297361b/Eve.en: Shi Houjiu glances down at the two of them,<NL>sees their pitiful state, and looks beyond pleased. He bursts out laughing.<NL>"What the elder just said is true. Martial arts have their levels, just like people.<NL>But we're all Emei disciples in the end, even if we belong to different branches. We should strive to live in harmony.<NL>Still, if we're not strict about this, people will get careless. All it takes is one misstep to fall into the corrupted path...<NL>Martial arts are rooted in killing. And swords have no eyes. So please—treat this seriously. But do try to hold back!"

210dcdd1-f5d5-4156-abf6-9bc7a297361b/Opt.en: (This bastard... He clearly wants to destroy Emei from the inside out.)
210dcdd1-f5d5-4156-abf6-9bc7a297361b/Opt.ru: (Этот ублюдок... Он явно хочет уничтожить Эмэй изнутри.)

3187e7f0-4765-4bd2-a5b6-d17bd84968a6/Eve.en: At this point, it's too late to back down. There's no choice but to follow through.<NL>Though every Emei disciple has their own thoughts, they still take the stage in turn and start their matches, following the rules of the Grand Tournament...<NL>Shi Houjiu narrows his eyes and locks onto the duel stage, paying no more attention to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> or White Ape lying off to the side.

65cc51c4-213f-4a94-a453-f1cb746bf4da/Eve.en: But then, just as he's smiling, something changes.<NL>His face darkens. Cold glints spark in his eyes.<NL>With a snap, the wine cup in his hand shatters, but he doesn't even flinch...
65cc51c4-213f-4a94-a453-f1cb746bf4da/Eve.ru: Но затем, как только он улыбается, что-то меняется.<NL>Его лицо мрачнеет. В его глазах вспыхивают холодные искорки.<NL>С треском кубок с вином в его руке разбивается вдребезги, но он даже не вздрагивает...

fe1a063c-f0a4-4d8c-99f8-0c4e8d0b035f/Eve.en: Turns out the two elite disciples currently on stage are doing exactly what Shi Houjiu warned against,<NL>fighting with flowery moves but no real power.<NL>They exchange fifty or sixty blows, but every strike is just for show.<NL>No speed, no True Qi, and the few times they do land a hit, it's no more painful than a shoulder rub...

fe1a063c-f0a4-4d8c-99f8-0c4e8d0b035f/Opt.en: (No way Shi Houjiu can sit through this.)
fe1a063c-f0a4-4d8c-99f8-0c4e8d0b035f/Opt.ru: (Ши Хоуджу ни за что не выдержит этого.)

083dca89-1fe0-470f-9b0f-7db11c8774fb/Eve.en: Just as expected, Shi Houjiu slams the table and stands, clearly about to erupt—<NL>only for the elder who visited the prison last night to suddenly step forward, frowning, and bark out:<NL>"You two useless fools! Don't you dare think Elder Shi's goodwill means you can half-ass your way through this!<NL>If you'd trained seriously, would you be embarrassing yourselves like this right now? Keep messing around and I'll have you both dragged off and executed!"<NL>The two disciples freeze in place, then suddenly drop to their knees, begging for forgiveness over and over...<NL>

083dca89-1fe0-470f-9b0f-7db11c8774fb/Opt.en: (They've gotta be his people. That acting was way too good...)
083dca89-1fe0-470f-9b0f-7db11c8774fb/Opt.ru: (Они, должно быть, его люди. Эта игра была слишком хороша...)

bb28ecbc-0292-4386-9fe3-642b06dc9ccc/Eve.en: The elder continues,<NL>"Fine, fine. Your failure is my fault. I haven't been strict enough.<NL>But if we let this kind of shameful nonsense continue and Elder Shi thinks Emei's younger generation is hopeless,<NL>the disgrace will be on us all..."<NL>Then he lets out a loud laugh and calls out, "Elders! Let's go show them how it's done!"

bb28ecbc-0292-4386-9fe3-642b06dc9ccc/Opt.en: (The four elders are about to make their move...)

43687f71-b88e-49c4-987f-ba80d61380a0/Eve.en: Before Shi Houjiu can even respond, the four of them leap onto the duel platform.<NL>The kneeling disciples know what's up, slipping quietly offstage the moment their elders spoke.<NL>Now the four elders each take a corner—one with a sword, one with piercers, and the other two with bare hands. They square off in pairs.<NL>Wind howls across the stage. The four of them clash in a blur of blade and fist, shadows darting like lightning.<NL>It's tight, fast, ruthless. Only then does Shi Houjiu's expression start to ease...

b527d3c4-d168-43c2-b620-fb755ccd95b5/Eve.en: As they continue trading blows, they fly through a hundred moves in no time. The martial arts they use are dazzling.<NL>These are high-level stuff rarely seen by younger disciples. The whole crowd is glued to the action, stunned by the speed and skill...<NL>Then—something happens.<NL>
b527d3c4-d168-43c2-b620-fb755ccd95b5/Eve.ru: Продолжая обмениваться ударами, они пролетают сотню ходов в мгновение ока. Боевые искусства, которые они используют, ослепительны.<NL>Это вещи высокого уровня, которые редко видят младшие ученики. Вся толпа прикована к происходящему, ошеломленная скоростью и мастерством...<NL>Затем — что-то происходит.<NL>

126de338-4297-45d8-ada7-9b1e2b389f92/Eve.en: A sharp sound slices through the air—shhhk! A flash of white streaks across the stage. It looks like a concealed weapon.<NL>But no—on closer look, it's a sword flying from the fight, aimed straight at Shi Houjiu's seat!<NL>
126de338-4297-45d8-ada7-9b1e2b389f92/Eve.ru: Резкий звук прорезает воздух — шшшшк! Вспышка белых полос по сцене. Это похоже на Скрытое оружие.<NL>Но нет — при ближайшем рассмотрении оказывается, что это Меч, вылетающий из боя и нацеленный прямо в кресло Ши Хоуджу!<NL>

126de338-4297-45d8-ada7-9b1e2b389f92/Opt.en: (Doesn't matter if he dodges or not. He's not gonna stay calm after this...)
126de338-4297-45d8-ada7-9b1e2b389f92/Opt.ru: (Не имеет значения, увернется он или нет. Он не успокоится после этого...)

eb176886-64e0-4a22-aefd-3acf4a5781c2/Eve.en: Shi Houjiu lets out a cold snort. With a single strike of his palm, the sword is blasted aside,<NL>veering off course with a clang! It slams into one of the Jingding Hall's pillars and buries itself several cuns deep.<NL>The hilt keeps trembling. Gasps echo through the hall!
eb176886-64e0-4a22-aefd-3acf4a5781c2/Eve.ru: Ши Хоуджу холодно фыркает. Одним ударом ладони Меч отлетает в сторону,<NL>с лязгом отклоняюсь от курса! Он врезается в одну из колонн зала Цзиндин и погружается на несколько футов вглубь.<NL>Рукоять продолжает дрожать. Вздохи эхом разносятся по залу!

715503ef-b6d6-49c4-a0d3-b1107e1b20b3/Eve.en: But the gasps aren't just about the sword because in that same flash of chaos,<NL>more objects come flying from the platform, like a storm of concealed weapons:<NL>Piercers. Gloves. Jade pendants. Rings. They whistle through the air, all aimed at the head of the hall!
715503ef-b6d6-49c4-a0d3-b1107e1b20b3/Eve.ru: Но вздохи связаны не только с Мечом, потому что в той же вспышке хаоса,<NL>с платформы летят новые предметы, похожие на шквал Скрытого оружия:<NL>Пирсинг. Перчатки. Подвески из Нефрита. Звонит. Они свистят в воздухе, все нацелены в голову зала!

e9f65b1b-43bf-4686-bb10-66a02058688e/Eve.en: Shi Houjiu's fury boils over.<NL>He lets out a shrill screech and leaps off his seat, shooting toward the platform like a hawk.<NL>He draws his sword mid-air and strikes the moment he lands. His moves are fast and fierce.<NL>The four elders exchange a look, then each leap back, circling him in four directions to dodge and defend.<NL>Shi Houjiu's attacks are vicious and lightning-fast. But even after twenty moves exchanged, not a single drop of blood touches his blade.<NL>The crowd can't believe their eyes. Then a sharp-eyed disciple suddenly shouts, "They're using the Four Symbols Lotus Array!"<NL>

e9f65b1b-43bf-4686-bb10-66a02058688e/Opt.en: (If White Ape hadn't warned them in advance, those four elders would've been dead or crippled in a single strike...)
e9f65b1b-43bf-4686-bb10-66a02058688e/Opt.ru: (Если бы Белая Обезьяна не предупредила их заранее, эти четверо старейшин были бы мертвы или искалечены одним ударом...)

e95416ac-950d-4a50-b05d-cf946446fa88/Eve.en: As the clash drags on, one Emei elder suddenly bursts out laughing.<NL>"What a clever twist on the Substitution Kung Fu!<NL>Elder Shi swapped the martial art that targets limbs for one that hits the ribs. You turned a graceful flourish into a sneak attack. Gotta admit, it's tricky to deal with.<NL>But the original move looked like a maiden picking lotus flowers. This version? More like a farmer yanking melons!"<NL>

6d1f3dc1-50b7-4fc8-bcdc-0718f734b1f6/Eve.en: Another elder speaks with a heavy voice.<NL>"That Spiritsnake's Fang was something too.<NL>You turned a leg-targeting martial art into a stab at the heart. Clever, sure. Brutal, even.<NL>But the original was fast as lightning, like a snake striking water. Elder Shi's version, using a sword instead, looks more like hammering nails into a coffin..."<NL>

6fa694f6-f345-42d2-9859-879e5af4f427/Eve.en: The third elder cuts in coldly.<NL>"But I'd say the most brilliant move was Elder Shi's solo version of the Four Symbols Lotus Array,<NL>which he tried back by the mountain stream.<NL>That formation's meant to be done by four people moving in sync. He tried to do it all by himself.<NL>Of course he looks frantic. Must be exhausting!"

a0a29c19-98ac-4f2d-a4ed-2c8f45a1b078/Eve.en: The lead elder then steps forward and speaks solemnly.<NL>"And then there's our sect's unique art, the Divine Sword of the Jade Maiden. Elder Shi's take on it is inventive.<NL>The Jade Maiden moves with lightness, grace, and an almost ethereal air—her swordplay soft and hard to pin down.<NL>Elder Shi, on the other hand, fights like a madman—vicious, venomous, and anything but elegant..."<NL>

bf65271d-f3d6-4cb7-b9ce-6d6a4cae1188/Eve.en: The four elders speak loud and clear, their voices powered by Qi.<NL>Everyone in the hall hears every word.<NL>The crowd instantly erupts because all the techniques they just described match the fatal wounds from the earlier string of murders.<NL>Hundreds of eyes now lock onto Shi Houjiu. Some with fear. Some with shock. Some with fury. Some with doubt...<NL>

33a33b57-0245-4632-ab79-11f57b68af23/Eve.en: But even under that piercing gaze, Shi Houjiu doesn't flcun. He keeps a calm smirk and slowly says,<NL>"Well then... since you've all decided not to trust me and would rather wallow in ignorance, I might as well give you what you want..."<NL>With a shout, the steel sword in his hand silently shatters into twenty or thirty sharp shards, floating mid-air.<NL>With a wave of his palms, the broken blades shoot out like a storm of concealed weapons and shooting stars, aimed straight at the four elders!<NL>

33a33b57-0245-4632-ab79-11f57b68af23/Opt.en: (Damn it! He's way stronger than we thought!)
33a33b57-0245-4632-ab79-11f57b68af23/Opt.ru: (Черт возьми! Он намного сильнее, чем мы думали!)

105392d0-58d7-47c5-82c6-3c735d4ae4c6/Eve.en: The elders try to move, to dodge,<NL>but the moment they shift, their True Qi stutters. It's as if something's blocking their flow.<NL>Their minds cloud up, coordination breaks down, and even the Four Symbols Lotus Array falls apart...<NL>Suddenly, four screams ring out from the stage, followed by more cries of alarm from the crowd!<NL>

105392d0-58d7-47c5-82c6-3c735d4ae4c6/Opt.en: (I can't wait anymore. I've got to get up—!)
105392d0-58d7-47c5-82c6-3c735d4ae4c6/Opt.ru: (Я больше не могу ждать. Мне нужно вставать!)

a21269b9-fa7f-4028-824f-266a8be9f62b/Eve.en: But before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can act, a gray shadow flashes past.<NL>Someone leaps onto the stage like a bolt of lightning!<NL>That figure moves fast. Mid-air, one palm strikes out at Shi Houjiu while the other hand spins a staff to block the incoming concealed weapons. Shi Houjiu steps in to counter, throwing his own palm strike.<NL>Their palms clash three times, and their Qis collide.<NL>Shi Houjiu coughs hard, blood seeping from his lips, and stumbles back three steps!

a21269b9-fa7f-4028-824f-266a8be9f62b/Opt.en: (White Ape's still hurt and splitting his focus to block those concealed weapons makes things worse!)
a21269b9-fa7f-4028-824f-266a8be9f62b/Opt.ru: (Белая обезьяна все еще ранен, и разделение его внимания на блокирование этого Скрытого оружия только усугубляет ситуацию!)

40603581-bcce-4a5b-a97c-208bb418880b/Eve.en: Sure enough, though White Ape attacks fiercely, it only takes moments for him to falter.<NL>His knees hit the ground. He can't stand, and his Inner Breath's in chaos...<NL><NL>The crowd stares, stunned.<NL>A few seconds later, someone shouts praise. Whispers rise:<NL>"It's that white ape!"<NL>"If he hadn't stepped in, we'd have way more dead right now..."<NL>"With Attainment and heart like that, how could he possibly be the killer?"

40603581-bcce-4a5b-a97c-208bb418880b/Opt.en: (The misunderstanding is cleared. I should be glad. But right now, I'm just worried...)
40603581-bcce-4a5b-a97c-208bb418880b/Opt.ru: (Недоразумение устранено. Я должен быть рад. Но прямо сейчас я просто волнуюсь...)

dd957572-949b-4d74-b15c-88976edc1674/Eve.en: "You old fool... Didn't think you'd wake up,"<NL>Shi Houjiu growls, seething. "So all that weird behavior before, just a setup!<NL>I should've killed you last night when I had the chance!"<NL><NL>White Ape says nothing. Suddenly, he stiffens and coughs up blood. The wounds on his body split open again.

0c6c888e-139a-4969-ac30-7a844295194f/Eve.en: That last clash—his True Qi surged too wildly.<NL>He couldn't hold it in and forced the blood out...<NL>Shi Houjiu freezes, then bursts into laughter. "Spent force. What can you possibly do to stop me now?"<NL>
0c6c888e-139a-4969-ac30-7a844295194f/Eve.ru: То последнее столкновение — его Истинная ци поднялась слишком сильно.<NL>Он не смог сдержаться и с Мощью выпустил кровь...<NL>Ши Хоуджу замирает, затем разражается смехом. - Потраченная Мощь. Что ты можешь сделать, чтобы остановить меня сейчас?"<NL>

0c6c888e-139a-4969-ac30-7a844295194f/Opt.en: (I have to move now! I've got to protect White Ape!)
0c6c888e-139a-4969-ac30-7a844295194f/Opt.ru: (Я должен двигаться сейчас же! Я должен защитить Белую обезьяну!)

9a0a00ae-4ada-42fb-b13d-1a9a0c3603c0/Eve.en: In the blink of an eye, White Ape coughs up another mouthful of blood.<NL>He's barely defending himself. Shi Houjiu's twin palms crash down like waves in a storm, pushing him back step by step.<NL>White Ape's breath grows heavier. His stance falters, and his defeat is near...
9a0a00ae-4ada-42fb-b13d-1a9a0c3603c0/Eve.ru: В мгновение ока Белая обезьяна выкашливает еще один глоток крови.<NL>Он едва ли защищается. Сдвоенные ладони Ши Хоуджиу обрушиваются вниз, как волны во время шторма, отбрасывая его назад шаг за шагом.<NL>Дыхание Белой обезьяны становится тяжелее. Его Стойка пошатнулась, и его поражение близко...

6335f2be-f881-4254-bce9-a3d1a71b1645/Eve.en: At that critical moment, someone leaps onto the stage,<NL>landing in front of White Ape and taking Shi Houjiu's next strike head-on!<NL>White Ape looks up in shock and shouts,<NL><NL>"Taiwu, help me! Cleanse our sect!"
6335f2be-f881-4254-bce9-a3d1a71b1645/Eve.ru: В этот критический момент кто-то запрыгивает на сцену,<NL>приземляюсь перед Белой обезьяной и принимаю следующий удар Ши Хоуджу в лоб!<NL>Белая обезьяна в шоке поднимает голову и кричит,<NL><NL>- Тайу, помоги мне! Очисти нашу Секту!"

47ae130c-2b86-4407-84e4-ab1b50956992/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> slams into Shi Houjiu, knocking him back.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> finally vents the rage that's been building for days.<NL>With one powerful strike, Shi Houjiu spits blood and staggers backward several steps... then suddenly topples over.<NL>His head hits the floor with a loud crack...

47ae130c-2b86-4407-84e4-ab1b50956992/Opt.en: (But this bastard's tough. He might not be down for good...)
47ae130c-2b86-4407-84e4-ab1b50956992/Opt.ru: (Но этот ублюдок крепкий орешек. Возможно, он спустился не насовсем...)

4b208875-d2ac-4944-be0a-5e56413c036c/Eve.en: "You all...<NL>ganged up on me... it's not a fair fight... I—I refuse to accept this..."<NL>Shi Houjiu groans in pain, his face streaked with tears, blood, and dirt. His words are slurred, and all the pride from earlier is gone.<NL>Even the female disciples who once admired his looks now turn away in disgust...

4b208875-d2ac-4944-be0a-5e56413c036c/Opt.en: (To avoid future trouble... I should just finish him off right now.)
4b208875-d2ac-4944-be0a-5e56413c036c/Opt.ru: (Чтобы избежать неприятностей в будущем... Я должен просто прикончить его прямо сейчас.)

7ba7419a-7428-43eb-9b0f-a50e08492dcb/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> seizes the moment and raises a hand to strike,<NL>but before the blow lands, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> suddenly feels <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> shoulder sink. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> arm won't move, no matter how hard <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> tries...

a20552a9-3d9c-4bc3-a6b6-cf042b601cf5/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> turns and sees White Ape standing behind <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>,<NL>one claw resting on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> shoulder.<NL>White Ape slowly shakes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> head. "Taiwu, let it go..."

20581f08-3e97-40b6-98d5-516aacab1737/Eve.en: White Ape sighs, but offers no explanation. He simply asks,<NL>"Why are you so obsessed with being the strongest in the world?"<NL>
20581f08-3e97-40b6-98d5-516aacab1737/Eve.ru: Белая обезьяна вздыхает, но ничего не объясняет. Он просто спрашивает,<NL>"Почему ты так одержим идеей быть самым сильным в мире?"<NL>

20581f08-3e97-40b6-98d5-516aacab1737/Opt.en: (I remember Shi Houjiu once said it was so no one dares mess with him...)
20581f08-3e97-40b6-98d5-516aacab1737/Opt.ru: (Я помню, Ши Хоуджу однажды сказал, что это для того, чтобы никто не смел с ним связываться...)

e6485dae-1a43-4767-9391-a4d091a09fc6/Eve.en: "That bastard deserves to die!"<NL>"Sir, after everything he did to you, you still want to spare him? That's just asking for trouble!"<NL>"A monster like him who slaughtered our Emei brothers! He should never be allowed to live!"<NL>The crowd roars in outrage once again...
e6485dae-1a43-4767-9391-a4d091a09fc6/Eve.ru: "Этот ублюдок заслуживает смерти!"<NL>- Сэр, после всего, что он вам сделал, вы все еще хотите пощадить его? Это просто напрашивается на неприятности!"<NL>- Такой же монстр, как он, который убил наших братьев Эмэй! Ему ни в коем случае нельзя позволять жить!"<NL>Толпа снова возмущенно ревет...

e6485dae-1a43-4767-9391-a4d091a09fc6/Opt.ru: (Все в ярости... Теперь их не успокоить...)

201317da-48b0-4e79-bacb-2fbdd6ae3ae8/Eve.en: "Cough... I met your founder once... He was lying in the woods, barely clinging to life..."<NL>White Ape suddenly begins to speak, his voice faint and raspy. It almost sounds like he's dreaming.<NL><NL>But at the mention of the founder, the crowd quiets down in reverence.<NL>Even those full of anger hold their tongues and listen...

f4816818-15db-47c2-b9ac-27e354ad1541/Eve.en: "I asked him,<NL>'You're badly hurt. If no one helps you soon, you won't make it.<NL>I could save you, but I don't know if you're a good man or a wicked one.<NL>What should I do?'"
f4816818-15db-47c2-b9ac-27e354ad1541/Eve.ru: - Я спросил его,<NL>- Ты серьезно ранен. Если никто не поможет вам в ближайшее время, у вас ничего не получится.<NL>Я мог бы спасти тебя, но я не знаю, хороший ты человек или злой.<NL>Что мне следует делать?"

f4816818-15db-47c2-b9ac-27e354ad1541/Opt.en: (If you save a good man, that's a blessing. But if you save a bad man, it could spell disaster...)
f4816818-15db-47c2-b9ac-27e354ad1541/Opt.ru: (Если вы спасаете хорошего человека, это благословение. Но если вы спасете плохого человека, это может обернуться катастрофой...)

20446b8e-bcba-45c4-a3f8-90f6f3e2ce79/Eve.en: "He didn't pretend. He just said with all the strength he had:<NL>'Old monkey, yesterday I hunted a wild rabbit and ate it. It tasted great.<NL>Today I treated another wild rabbit's wounds, and I took care not to hurt even a hair.<NL>So would you say I'm good, or evil?'<NL><NL>I thought about that for a long time.<NL>He was already close to death when it hit me. Whatever the answer is, saving a life comes first.<NL>Even when I reached out to help him, I still hadn't figured out if he was good or bad..."

20446b8e-bcba-45c4-a3f8-90f6f3e2ce79/Opt.en: (White Ape acted out of kindness, not judgment...)
20446b8e-bcba-45c4-a3f8-90f6f3e2ce79/Opt.ru: (Белая обезьяна действовала по доброте душевной, а не по осуждению...)

2e0cf721-6933-4646-b8a4-7d7b975c7a0e/Eve.en: "And before he left, he told me,<NL>'Old monkey, I've been stubborn all my life. I can't stand injustice, and I always want to meddle.<NL>From here on, I'll likely kill more and more. I might have no way to deal with it.<NL>You saved my life and taught me martial arts. That makes you my teacher. One day, this killing urge will come back to you...<NL>I'll owe you for it. My hands are stained in blood. I'll never wash that away. But if it brings peace to Emei, I'll accept whatever punishment comes.<NL>If you won't shoulder that burden, I'll return this life to you right now. But whatever bond we have... it won't end here.'<NL><NL>I refused to take his life. So he just laughed and left..."

2e0cf721-6933-4646-b8a4-7d7b975c7a0e/Opt.en: (So-called bond... for every gain, there's always a loss. And every loss leads to something gained. There's no clear end to it.)
2e0cf721-6933-4646-b8a4-7d7b975c7a0e/Opt.ru: (Так называемая связь... за каждым приобретением всегда стоит потеря. И каждая потеря приводит к чему-то приобретенному. У этого нет четкого конца.)

fc76a3aa-b25e-4148-b11d-a84de6eb55eb/Eve.en: "Later, he returned victorious. He asked me again,<NL>'Old monkey, now tell me. Am I good or bad?'<NL><NL>Without thinking, I replied,<NL>'I thought I'd save you if you were good, and leave you if you were bad.<NL>But when the time came, the only thing left in my heart was—do I want to save you?'<NL><NL>He laughed loud and deep, bowed to the ground, and said,<NL>'You've truly reached enlightenment, sir!'"

fc76a3aa-b25e-4148-b11d-a84de6eb55eb/Opt.en: When the heart is true, the path reveals itself. Good and evil are just reflections of heart and fate.
fc76a3aa-b25e-4148-b11d-a84de6eb55eb/Opt.ru: Когда сердце истинно, путь открывается сам собой. Добро и зло - это всего лишь отражения сердца и судьбы.

14b4ff15-bc6a-43c4-930c-e3618b4e8472/Eve.en: "All things in this world are reflections of heart and fate...<NL>Love and hate, life and death—if we can't break free of gain and loss, how can we ever follow our true will?"<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> murmurs softly, suddenly understanding something.
14b4ff15-bc6a-43c4-930c-e3618b4e8472/Eve.ru: "Все вещи в этом мире являются отражением сердца и судьбы...<NL>Любовь и ненависть, жизнь и смерть — если мы не можем освободиться от приобретений и потерь, как мы вообще сможем следовать своей истинной воле?"<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> тихо бормочет, внезапно что-то понимая.

14b4ff15-bc6a-43c4-930c-e3618b4e8472/Opt.en: (But honestly... how many people in this world can truly break free of gain and loss?)
14b4ff15-bc6a-43c4-930c-e3618b4e8472/Opt.ru: (Но, честно говоря... сколько людей в этом мире действительно могут освободиться от приобретений и потерь?)

3912b545-00b5-4f04-a9ab-323f95404ddd/Eve.en: Many Emei disciples in the crowd nod along, deep in thought...<NL>Some sigh and stomp their feet, realizing that compared to revenge, their hearts are already leaning in another direction. Quietly, they start to leave.<NL>Before long, the crowd begins to thin out. Less than a third of the original audience remains below the stage...

9fb46a78-260c-463c-9bca-6e66cb61acb4/Eve.en: As for White Ape and Shi Houjiu, their condition is dire.<NL>White Ape is barely breathing, looking like he could collapse at any moment...<NL>Shi Houjiu stares blankly, and his eyes are lost. His hands slowly reach up, trying to remove White Ape's claw resting gently on his head...
9fb46a78-260c-463c-9bca-6e66cb61acb4/Eve.ru: Что касается Белой обезьяны и Ши Хоуджиу, то их состояние тяжелое.<NL>Белая обезьяна едва дышит, выглядит так, словно может упасть в обморок в любой момент...<NL>Ши Хоуджу безучастно смотрит на него, и в глазах у него растерянность. Его руки медленно тянутся вверх, пытаясь убрать коготь Белой обезьяны, мягко лежащий у него на голове...

9fb46a78-260c-463c-9bca-6e66cb61acb4/Opt.en: (Oh no! White Ape can't push himself any further...)
9fb46a78-260c-463c-9bca-6e66cb61acb4/Opt.ru: (О нет! Белая обезьяна не может продвинуться дальше...)

d8bd0af0-d36e-4830-ae44-52f34fe953a9/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> hurries forward and catches White Ape before he falls,<NL>quickly checking his pulse while sending <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> own True Qi into him.<NL>White Ape blinks, glancing first at Shi Houjiu, then at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>,<NL>and finally manages to force a faint smile onto his sunken face...

d8bd0af0-d36e-4830-ae44-52f34fe953a9/Opt.en: (Thank goodness... his vitality's weak, but there's still hope.)
d8bd0af0-d36e-4830-ae44-52f34fe953a9/Opt.ru: (Слава богу... его жизненные силы слабы, но надежда все еще есть.)

18097ba5-9982-40ef-a109-44e49d314da6/Eve.en: "Master..."<NL>Whether from the heavy toll of White Ape's life-saving technique or the emotional blow just now,<NL>Shi Houjiu continues to stare in a daze, face expressionless,<NL>but two silent tears roll down his cheeks...
18097ba5-9982-40ef-a109-44e49d314da6/Eve.ru: "Учитель..."<NL>То ли из-за тяжелых последствий техники спасения жизни Белой обезьяны, то ли из-за эмоционального удара, нанесенного только что,<NL>Ши Хоуджу продолжает смотреть в Оцепенении, лицо его ничего не выражает,<NL>но две беззвучные слезинки скатываются по его щекам...

18097ba5-9982-40ef-a109-44e49d314da6/Opt.en: (His whole presence is calm now—not a trace of killing intent left. He's like a different person.)
18097ba5-9982-40ef-a109-44e49d314da6/Opt.ru: (Теперь все его присутствие спокойно — не осталось и следа намерения убить. Он как будто другой человек.)

836a781b-f660-4fe7-9e40-e9ec63e50e9c/Eve.en: At this point,<NL>only a handful of people remain in the square. They've all calmed down, quietly reflecting.<NL>No one's paying attention to what's happening on the stage anymore. No one shows any desire to harm Shi Houjiu either.<NL>They chew over White Ape's words, then bow their heads and quickly leave...<NL><NL>Before long, Emei Jingding Hall is completely silent. Not a single disciple remains.<NL>If not for the leftover food and chairs, one might think the Grand Tournament never happened at all...

fc0e458b-b43c-4079-922a-e06b71703d56/Eve.en: With <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s True Qi helping him recover,<NL>White Ape rests quietly on the dueling platform. After a while, he finally gathers his breath and says his goodbyes.<NL>He says his business here is done, and he's ready to take Little Shi and return to the mountains, to keep quietly guarding Emei.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> doesn't want to part, but respects his decision, and watches the two figures slowly walk away...

fc0e458b-b43c-4079-922a-e06b71703d56/Opt.en: (The Emei conflict ends here. I've done what I set out to do...)
fc0e458b-b43c-4079-922a-e06b71703d56/Opt.ru: (На этом конфликт в Эмэи заканчивается. Я сделал то, что намеревался сделать...)

8a1587c2-d0f1-46b4-87c0-7b3a9cadbc40/Eve.en: As for the Ancestor's Secret Order,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has already handed it back to White Ape, with a promise.<NL>Once he has time, he'll return to the old place at the foot of the cliff to spar and cultivate together again...
8a1587c2-d0f1-46b4-87c0-7b3a9cadbc40/Eve.ru: Что же касается Тайного приказа Предка,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> уже вернул его Белой обезьяне с обещанием.<NL>Как только у него появится время, он вернется на старое место у подножия утеса, чтобы снова спарринговать и совершенствоваться вместе...

8a1587c2-d0f1-46b4-87c0-7b3a9cadbc40/Opt.en: (White Ape is a true master of martial arts. I'll need to visit him often for guidance...)
8a1587c2-d0f1-46b4-87c0-7b3a9cadbc40/Opt.ru: (Белая обезьяна - настоящий мастер Боевых искусств. Мне нужно будет часто навещать его за советом...)

19fd66bd-fe5d-4830-a033-28df03981d98/Eve.en: "It's just more of that Confucian, Buddhist, Taoist 'no-self, no-form' talk. You think I don't know that already, as an Emei elder?<NL>To me, those teachings are just ways to manipulate gullible fools!"<NL>
19fd66bd-fe5d-4830-a033-28df03981d98/Eve.ru: "Это просто еще один из тех конфуцианских, буддийских, даосских разговоров о "не-я, не-форме". Ты думаешь, я, как старейшина Эмэй, этого уже не знаю?<NL>Для меня эти учения - всего лишь способы манипулировать доверчивыми дураками!"<NL>

19fd66bd-fe5d-4830-a033-28df03981d98/Opt.en: Turns out what Shi Houjiu wanted all along—his so-called "enlightenment"—was just the power to walk the world without being bullied...
19fd66bd-fe5d-4830-a033-28df03981d98/Opt.ru: Оказывается, то, чего Ши Хоуджу хотел все это время — его так называемое "просветление" - было просто возможностью ходить по миру, не подвергаясь издевательствам...

bea64127-3848-4a95-af15-66b8a5a61d24/Eve.en: Cleanup efforts begin.<NL>Some rush to cure the wounded. Others go search for the missing sect leader.<NL>Eventually, they find something suspicious in the back mountain's hidden tunnel. Thankfully, the sect leader is unharmed, just a bit exhausted after being imprisoned for days...
bea64127-3848-4a95-af15-66b8a5a61d24/Eve.ru: Начинаются работы по очистке.<NL>Некоторые спешат вылечить раненых. Другие отправляются на поиски пропавшего лидера Секты.<NL>В конце концов, они находят что-то подозрительное в потайном туннеле задней горы. К счастью, лидер Секты цел и невредим, просто немного измучен после многодневного заточения...

bea64127-3848-4a95-af15-66b8a5a61d24/Opt.en: (Thank goodness he's safe. Otherwise, Shi Houjiu would never be forgiven...)
bea64127-3848-4a95-af15-66b8a5a61d24/Opt.ru: (Слава богу, он в безопасности. Иначе Ши Хоуджу никогда бы не простили...)

8be6a3ee-a26e-49e3-88fc-4994a4203e2e/Eve.en: Under questioning, the sect leader admits he was captured for refusing to go along with Shi Houjiu's plan.<NL>Now free, he returns to his position with renewed determination and works harder than ever...
8be6a3ee-a26e-49e3-88fc-4994a4203e2e/Eve.ru: На допросе лидер Секты признает, что был схвачен за отказ согласиться с планом Ши Хоуджу.<NL>Теперь, освободившись, он возвращается на свою должность с новой решимостью и работает усерднее, чем когда-либо...

8be6a3ee-a26e-49e3-88fc-4994a4203e2e/Opt.en: (Given time, the Emei Sect will surely recover its former glory...)
8be6a3ee-a26e-49e3-88fc-4994a4203e2e/Opt.ru: (Со временем Секта Эмэй наверняка восстановит свою былую славу...)

e5bc3522-8440-41ce-b25e-8c8118ffb6ad/Eve.en: Word spreads: At Emei's recent Grand Tournament, disaster struck without warning.<NL>The scene afterward was pure carnage, with bodies everywhere.<NL>Turns out the chaos was caused by an internal power struggle. Two factions clashed fiercely.<NL>Thankfully, Elder Shi Houjiu stepped in just in time. The culprit behind the severed hand murders and his crew? All taken out on the spot...

e5bc3522-8440-41ce-b25e-8c8118ffb6ad/Opt.en: (If only I'd arrived sooner, maybe I could've stopped the bloodshed...)
e5bc3522-8440-41ce-b25e-8c8118ffb6ad/Opt.ru: (Если бы только я приехал раньше, возможно, мне удалось бы остановить кровопролитие...)

66feef7c-0275-4a3b-af32-ddaa5295367d/Eve.en: Word spreads: At Emei's recent Grand Tournament, disaster struck without warning.<NL>The scene afterward was pure carnage, with bodies everywhere. The culprit behind the severed hand murders and his crew? All taken out on the spot...

66feef7c-0275-4a3b-af32-ddaa5295367d/Opt.en: (If only I'd arrived sooner, maybe I could've stopped the bloodshed...)
66feef7c-0275-4a3b-af32-ddaa5295367d/Opt.ru: (Если бы только я приехал раньше, возможно, мне удалось бы остановить кровопролитие...)

4cf4b743-86e7-4a3f-8b92-b2953ec01346/Eve.en: Word spreads: At Emei's recent Grand Tournament, disaster struck without warning.<NL>The scene afterward was pure carnage, with bodies everywhere.
